← Play The Waiting Game

Eight seconds at the café.

Watch a little coffee rush, then compare two versions of the same day. “Nolal” means “eh, I’ll take it.” What happens when everyone accepts a mix-up?

Silent demo: customers queue and collect drinks during 20× playback. The view then cuts to a completed comparison. Remaking every mix-up gives 44 people their intended drink and 9 walkouts. Accepting every mix-up gives 39 intended drinks, 14 accepted wrong drinks and no walkouts. These are results from one synthetic day.
